generator.item_arrival_delay_interpretation: Fixed 18-second item action arrivals share the answer-phase start origin. Generator lateness is observed invocation minus planned arrival; service waits can make later arrivals late.

persistence.known_fact_scope: Durable emitted event/checkpoint material and actual ACKs only; does not establish a complete workflow or capacity acceptance.

extraction_note: Top-level errors are grouped by actual phase/error fields; request failures retain error_type.
